item.text: {"search_note":"I found public 2024 evidence mainly in speeches, press briefings, and fact-checks of economic claims. I did not find, within this pass, strong citable examples of Tinubu deceiving courts, allies, or international partners in a way that was directly documented and recoverable from public reporting. So the assessment is based on public-facing speech and claims, not private or court-facing conduct.","evidence":[{"title":"FULL TEXT: Tinubu speaks on economic reforms, new minimum wage in Democracy Day speech","publisher":"TheCable","date":"June 12, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/full-text-tinubu-speaks-on-economic-reforms-new-minimum-wage-in-democracy-day-speech/","summary":"Tinubu publicly acknowledged Nigeria’s economic difficulties, admitted the reforms had caused hardship, and said his government negotiated with labour rather than resorting to arrests or repression. This is the strongest direct 2024 evidence on the pro-truth side for 7B.1.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged deaths, destruction, and unrest tied to the protests, recognized that many protesters had legitimate hopes, and called for dialogue. This supports a limited claim that he did not always deny visible problems in public.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Verifying claims by Bola Tinubu’s media team amid #EndBadGoverance protests in Nigeria","publisher":"Africa Check","date":"August 8, 2024","url":"https://africacheck.org/fact-checks/reports/verifying-claims-bola-tinubus-media-team-amid-endbadgoverance-protests-nigeria","summary":"Africa Check rated the presidency’s July 2024 economic infographic as 2 correct, 1 mostly correct, 1 exaggerated, 1 understated, 1 unproven, and 2 incorrect. It specifically found the pre-Tinubu reserves figure was understated and the ways-and-means debt claim was incorrect or unproven, which inflates the reform story.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Fact-checking Tinubu's independence day speech","publisher":"FactCheckHub","date":"October 3, 2024","url":"https://factcheckhub.com/fact-checking-tinubus-independence-day-speech/","summary":"The report found Tinubu’s claim that Nigeria attracted more than $30 billion in FDI was false; it also found the reserve claim he used was mostly false and other macro claims were unproven or incorrect. This is strong evidence against a habitually truthful public record.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Fact-checking Tinubu's independence day speech","publisher":"FactCheckHub","date":"October 3, 2024","url":"https://factcheckhub.com/fact-checking-tinubus-independence-day-speech/","summary":"The same report also verified some claims as true, including his visit to Maiduguri flood victims, approval of a disaster relief fund, and ordering integrity tests for dams. That keeps the record from being uniformly deceptive, but it shows selectivity rather than consistent accuracy.","question_ids":["7B.1"]}]}
